privacy.art1Body: OnMaru (hereinafter 'the Service') complies with the Personal Information Protection Act and related regulations to protect the freedom and rights of data subjects, and lawfully processes and safely manages personal information.
privacy.art2Intro: The Service collects and uses only the minimum personal information necessary:
privacy.art2GeneralRequired: Required: Device identifier, access logs, service usage records, browser environment information
privacy.art2GeneralOptional: Optional: Location information (for nearby hanok and stay search), saved/bookmark lists
privacy.art2KakaoItems: Collected: Kakao nickname, profile image URL (based on Kakao account consent items)
privacy.art2KakaoProcess: Processing: Upon successful Kakao OAuth authentication, an HttpOnly session cookie is issued by the server. Kakao access tokens are used only on the server and are not transmitted to the browser.
privacy.art2KakaoRetention: Retention: Immediately destroyed upon session expiry or logout
privacy.art2AiBody: Processing: Travel keywords and mood selections are used for AI journey generation. No personally identifiable information is included.
privacy.art3Body: The Service retains personal information until membership withdrawal or until the purpose of collection is fulfilled. Where retention is required by law, information is safely stored for the required period.
privacy.art3Session: Kakao login session cookie: Immediately deleted upon session expiry or logout
privacy.art3Logs: Service usage logs: Retained for up to 1 year then destroyed
privacy.art3Bookmarks: Bookmarks/saved lists: Immediately destroyed upon membership withdrawal request
privacy.art4Body: For inquiries, complaints, or remedies related to personal information processing, please contact us at:

terms.art1Body: These terms define the rights, obligations, and responsibilities regarding the conditions and procedures for using all services provided by OnMaru, including the Hanok Archive, Sorimaru Audio Docent, 3D Interactive Space Viewer, and AI Journey Curator.
terms.art2Item1: Traditional hanok and stay information based on Korea Tourism Organization TourAPI 4.0 and Odii audio
terms.art2Item2: Real-time solar altitude eave sunlight simulation and 7-step structural assembly 3D viewer
terms.art2Item3: 1-night 2-day themed journey curation based on K-Culture and regional heritage
terms.art2Item4: AI Journey Curator: Google Gemini-based AI analyzes user keywords and mood to generate customized hanok journey courses. Generated journeys can be saved and shared.
terms.art2Item5: Kakao Social Login: Quick login via Kakao account. Your Kakao nickname and profile image are used for your in-service profile.
terms.art3Intro: By using the AI Journey service, you agree to the following:
terms.art3Item1: AI-generated journey courses are for reference only and may differ from actual conditions.
terms.art3Item2: The accuracy or completeness of AI-generated results is not guaranteed, and we are not liable for any resulting damages.
terms.art3Item3: Keywords entered are processed only for journey generation and do not include personally identifiable information.
terms.art4Body: Intellectual property rights for self-produced 3D modeling, design systems, and UI/UX interaction code belong to OnMaru. Copyrights for public data connected through the public data portal belong to their respective source organizations.
terms.art5Body: The Service is exempt from liability when services cannot be temporarily provided due to force majeure such as natural disasters, public API server failures, or AI model service interruptions. Tourism information provided may also change based on real-time conditions.

publicData.introTitle: Korea Tourism Organization Public Data Usage Notice
publicData.introBody: OnMaru connects and utilizes reliable public data in accordance with the KOGL (Korea Open Government License) Type 1 Attribution standard provided by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and the Korea Tourism Organization.
publicData.apiItem1: Korea Tourism Organization Tourism Information Service (TourAPI 4.0 / KorService2): Hanok accommodations, tourist sites, cultural facilities, events/festivals
publicData.apiItem2: Tourism Audio Guide Open API (Odii): Historical stories and audio docent recordings of major traditional houses, palaces, and Confucian academies nationwide
publicData.apiItem3: Public Data Portal (data.go.kr): Cultural Heritage Administration national heritage metadata and local cultural tourism open data
publicData.copyrightBody: Some hanok images and description texts in this service are based on public works (Type 1: Attribution) provided through Korea Tourism Organization TourAPI 4.0 and Odii services.
publicData.metaDate: Data refresh cycle: Automatic hourly synchronization
